title: Issues installing xdrip+ on Sony SW3
body:
I’m trying to configure a sony sw3 to use xdrip+ when running but it’s getting difficult…

 

I’m using the last apk available on the web with the Android 1.5 firmware of the sw, installing the apk through ADB (is there any easier way to install it?).

 

I succeed in installing the apk, but when trying to run it, I got this message: “Unfortunately, xDrip+ has stopped”.

 

I really don’t know why it’s not working, I’ve already installed it through ADB twice, without big success.

 

Would you please help me?

 

Maybe I’m using a apk versión that is not adapted to that watch os? (Android wear 1.5)

 

Thank you again for your help.
